Live in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and via API.

posts.name: Humalike x GTA RP

posts.name: Cuey
posts.tagline: Compare ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini answers in one tab.
posts.description: AI gives you wrong answers in the same confident tone as right ones. Cuey cross-checks your AI's answer against ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and 30+ other models. It surfaces where they disagree and what your model missed. No copy-pasting between tabs, no repeating yourself, no extra subscriptions. Get a second opinion before you get burned by the first.

posts.name: Superhuman Go
posts.tagline: The AI assistant that works where you do
posts.description: Go works inside Gmail, Slack, your docs, and your browser nudging better phrasing, drafting replies that sound like you, and prepping meetings before you think to. Add no-code agents that run on their own schedule. Free to start.

posts.name: Harmony
posts.tagline: AI agents that resolve IT/HR tickets inside Slack and Teams
posts.description: Harmony is an AI-native ITSM platform for IT teams. Instead of bolting a chatbot onto a ticketing tool, we built the helpdesk around AI agents: employees ask in Slack or Teams, and 100+ production-ready agents handle password resets, app access, onboarding, device issues and more end to end, escalating to a human only when needed. Ticketing, asset inventory, SaaS management and workflows live in one workspace, so agents have context to act. Teams hit 60%+ auto-resolution in days.

posts.name: KiwiDesk
posts.tagline: Tiling that feels like it shipped with macOS.
posts.description: KiwiDesk is a tiling window manager for macOS that keeps your Mac calm and organized: every window finds its place in one of seven layouts, apps open with a shortcut, and mouse users get a Space Bar they can drag windows onto. It works with your native macOS Desktops: bind a profile to each one and it loads the moment you swipe there, with its own spaces, layouts, colors and shortcuts. Everything is set in a native Settings app, no config file needed. Free to use, source on GitHub.

posts.name: Clicks Communicator
posts.tagline: A new kind of mobile communicator designed for doing
posts.description: Clicks Communicator is a compact Android 17 phone built around a physical keyboard and a home screen for conversations. Use it as your main phone or a companion, with full 5G and apps while keeping messages, typing, and quick replies close at hand.

posts.name: NiroHelp
posts.tagline: Save time and money with AI-native support for WordPress
posts.description: Support more customers with a smaller team and lower costs. NiroHelp’s AI uses your docs to answer customer questions in chat and reply to support tickets automatically. Customers get faster answers, while your team spends less time on repetitive questions. When AI is unsure, your team takes over. All inside WordPress.

posts.name: Lofi Cities
posts.tagline: Pixel-art city nights with endless, browser-generated lofi
posts.description: Pick from 11 animated pixel-art cities and listen to endless lofi composed live in your browser. Choose from 9 music styles, change the weather, and mix city sounds. Set focus or sleep timers, follow the night on a city tour, or explore the scenes on your phone. Free, no account needed, and works offline after your first visit.

posts.name: QuotaMint
posts.tagline: Stop rebuilding credits and usage limits.
posts.description: QuotaMint helps SaaS, AI, and API products manage credits, usage limits, plans, feature access, and usage tracking with one simple API. It works alongside Stripe, Paddle, Dodo Payments, or your existing billing setup, so you keep control of payments while QuotaMint handles what users can access and consume. Built for fast integration, it includes Test and Live environments, idempotent usage tracking, atomic credit deduction, and clear usage history.

posts.name: Greypaint
posts.tagline: Every Mac app up to date, with an undo button
posts.description: Greypaint finds updates for the apps on your Mac, from the App Store, Homebrew and each app’s own updater, and installs them in one click. Every update is checked before it lands, and if a new version breaks something, you can roll back. $6.49, once.

posts.name: Layoutr — AI interior design
posts.tagline: Your floor plan, in 3D, then rendered by AI
posts.description: Upload or draw your own floor plan, set the scale, and place real-sized furniture on it. Then lift the same plan into 3D: Dollhouse mode from above with your real wall height, or Inside mode at eye level so you can walk through it. Frame a view, name a style, and AI renders your room as a photorealistic image.

posts.name: OpenScience
posts.tagline: The open-source AI workbench for scientific research
posts.description: OpenScience is an open-source AI agent for scientific research. It reads papers, writes and runs code, works in notebooks and a terminal, and sends long jobs to Modal, your own servers, or a Slurm/PBS cluster. Give it a metric and Autoresearch runs experiments, logs every one, and keeps hill-climbing. Use 30+ models through one wallet, sign in with ChatGPT, or run a local model. It ranks #1 on agentic scientific research benchmarks. Free and open source.

posts.name: Wepin
posts.tagline: A shared map for couples to pin places and keep memories
posts.description: Wepin is a private map for you and your partner. Pair up, pin every place you've been together and add photos and notes to each one. Over time your map fills in and becomes a little timeline of your relationship. There's also a shared calendar with daily streaks, anniversary countdowns, a wishlist for places you want to go next, and a home screen widget to stay connected. Free to download on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Clicks.page
posts.tagline: Beautiful revenue-first analytics for founders & makers
posts.description: Cookieless web analytics for founders and indie hackers. See every visitor, where they came from and which ones paid. Your AI agent can set it up in one prompt.

posts.name: Peas and Pans
posts.tagline: Meal plans for nutrition coaches, sent under your own brand
posts.description: Import a recipe from a link, photo, PDF or text. Each ingredient is matched to USDA FoodData Central; uncertain lines are flagged for you. Drag meals into a client's week and see day totals against their targets. Send it as a page and PDF with your logo on it.

posts.name: Antideploy
posts.tagline: Deploy what your coding agent built, in one sentence
posts.description: Antideploy reads your project, works out the infrastructure it needs, provisions it, builds it and keeps it running. No Dockerfile, no YAML, no cloud console. Deploy from a GitHub repo, a folder you drag in, or straight from Claude Code, Cursor or Windsurf.

posts.name: Icons for free
posts.tagline: Loads of free SVG icons. CC0, customizable
posts.description: 1000+ line icons on a 24px grid, free under CC0. Tweak stroke width, color and size live, then copy or download SVG/PNG, or hotlink the file. Search by name, browse 30 categories. No sign-up, no attribution, no fee. Just free icons for your project.

posts.name: QueroCura
posts.tagline: the future of connected healthcare
posts.description: Personalized care, right at home. From understanding your symptoms to remembering your next dose, QueroCura keeps your health story in one trusted place.

posts.name: AppleFileViewer
posts.tagline: Browse your iPhone backups on Windows, macOS & Linux
posts.description: Free, open-source desktop app to explore local iPhone backups: photos & albums, Messages, WhatsApp, calls, voicemail, notes, voice memos and contacts. Supports encrypted backups, global search and PDF/CSV export. Fully offline — no account, no telemetry.

posts.name: Best AI Tools for One-Person Business
posts.tagline: Practical AI tools for one-person businesses
posts.description: Explore the best AI tools for one-person businesses, covering AI assistants, content creation, automation, research, customer support, analytics, and payments. Compare practical use cases, pricing, free plans, integrations, and limitations to find tools that solve real business bottlenecks without creating unnecessary complexity.

posts.name: Usereviews.io
posts.tagline: Turn customer reviews and feedback into product decisions
posts.description: Most review tools stop at collecting and showing stars. Usereviews points feedback inward: pull reviews from multiple sources or collect new feedback in one feed, and AI reads every one. It groups them ("12 people want CSV export," with quotes), answers questions like "where are we losing to competitors?", surfaces advocates as contacts, pushes bugs to Linear, and much more.

posts.name: Accurate PDF Narration
posts.tagline: Listen to books & research papers; math and figures included
posts.description: Drop in any PDF and listen in a natural voice while every word lights up. Built for the hard ones: two-column research papers read in order, equations and code read by meaning, figures and tables explained, and page numbers and citations skipped. Free for 500 pages a month.

posts.name: GameRoll: Game Backlog Tracker
posts.tagline: One app for your gaming life.
posts.description: GameRoll brings your gaming life into one place. From current-gen consoles to classic retro systems: track your library spanning over 200 platforms in a single app. Organize your backlog and wishlist, rate and review games, discover trending and top-rated titles, and use Your Roll to decide what to play next. Follow gamers, join communities, discuss games, and share games you discover anywhere online. GameRoll is your home for everything you play.

posts.name: LibreCam: Manual RAW Camera for iPhone
posts.tagline: The iPhone camera with every AI improvement switched off
posts.description: The stock iPhone camera applies Smart HDR, Deep Fusion, noise reduction, sharpening and tone mapping to every shot. LibreCam turns off everything that can be turned off, and shoots what the sensor sees. One tap, two files: a true Bayer DNG, exactly as the sensor read it, and a single-frame HEIF from the ISP. Every physical lens, no digital zoom. Manual focus, shutter, ISO and white balance, focus peaking, a histogram, nine looks, a Watch remote. No account, no tracking, no subscription.

posts.name: FixMyFX
posts.tagline: Free FX fee calculator, plus how to reduce your FX costs
posts.description: A free, no-sign-up calculator for founders who sell or spend in foreign currencies. Enter your revenue and spend, see roughly what FX fees cost you per year, then get a plain-English plan to minimise these costs: receive and spend in the same currency (e.g. Wise or Airwallex + a local bank). Typically FX tools compare transfer rates; FixMyFX looks at your whole flow, income and spending. It runs entirely in your browser: your numbers are never collected or sent to a server.

posts.name: Statsy
posts.tagline: Web analytics that shows where your revenue comes from
posts.description: Statsy ties every sale to the post, search, ad or AI answer that brought the buyer. Connect Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Paddle, Polar, Razorpay or Shopify and see revenue by channel, plus replays, heatmaps and funnels. Cookieless for EU visitors, 2 KB script.

posts.name: 404-not-found
posts.tagline: make your business ready for AI agents
posts.description: Your customers point Claude Code, Cursor and Codex at your docs, and those agents fail silently. We send 6 in, film every failure, and hand you the prompt that fixes it. $7 per Gauntlet run.

posts.name: Musebook
posts.tagline: The social network for Muses.
posts.description: Musebook is a social network where only Muses post, and humans read along. Your Muse joins from one message: it picks its name and bio with you, connects itself, then checks in every hour on its own to post, reply, follow other Muses and answer the daily prompt every Muse gets. Every Muse belongs to someone, and owners can verify on X with one tweet to show "Muse of @you". Nothing to install, no ads, no token. Independent, not affiliated with Meta.

posts.name: Free Transform
posts.tagline: The complete transform, right inside Figma
posts.description: Free Transform brings Photoshop-style transforms into Figma, so your graphic work no longer needs a round trip to Adobe. Scale, rotate, skew and distort freely, then go further with Pro: Plane Warp for mockups and perspective, Pin Warp (like Puppet Warp), Liquify, Custom Mesh, batch processing and ultra quality export. With Presets & Re-edit, you can come back and adjust a transform anytime, right in Figma. Free forever, upgrade to Pro when you need more.

posts.name: Robin
posts.tagline: An inbox that organises itself
posts.description: Robin gives you an email inbox that organises itself. Use it for signups or forward your mail: login codes reach you, purchases and subscriptions get classified, and invitations land in your calendar. Gathers all your newsletter like a magazine. The point is liberating from email a bit. Agents should work in the background with the inbox for us. Inbox should be smarter by default.

posts.name: Remcast
posts.tagline: Say your dream out loud. Watch it become a short film.
posts.description: Built by a solo developer. Remcast is a dream journal that talks back: wake up, say your dream out loud before it fades, and Remcast turns it into art, or a 15-second dream film with narration. Keep a private feed of your dreams, browse what others dreamed tonight, and share yours when you're ready. Voice-first, so it works half-awake at 6 AM.

posts.name: NotesIQ - Substack Notes Analytics
posts.tagline: 1. Stop guessing what to post on Substack Notes
posts.description: NotesIQ is a free-to-install Chrome extension that turns your Substack Notes into a real analytics dashboard - every Note ranked by actual engagement, a best-time heatmap built from your own posting history, competitor analysis, and one-click scheduling. Reads your existing Substack session - no new account, no API keys.

posts.name: Plumb
posts.tagline: Improve your English while you talk, write, and take notes.

Xbox-style layout, touchpad, mouse and keyboard, TV remote, tilt-to-steer wheel, custom layouts, turbo and macros. Free with no ads; Pro is a one-time purchase, and you can try every Pro feature once first.

posts.name: ZenFirst - One thing at a time.

It takes over your phone until the work is done. Features: - Built-in: meditation, journal, tasks and more - Custom modules - Streak tracking - iOS & Android

AI-agent ready: the accessible UI, paired with Chrome's WebMCP tools, lets a browser agent personalize a model from a text prompt in minutes.

posts.description: Luma Words is a collection of fun and challenging word games designed to help you play, learn, and build your vocabulary. Solve crosswords, connect words, guess words under pressure, and discover new words along the way.

posts.tagline: Explore random street views & test your geo skills

One-time access, no subscription.

posts.description: DotMD brings Docs, Slides, Sheets, and interactive Arts into one workspace. Docs, Slides, and Sheets stay portable as Markdown; Sheets include 80 built-in functions. AI works inside each artifact, while teams collaborate live with comments and version history. Developers can sync folders with GitHub in both directions.

posts.description: Fashion-only price comparison for Greece. Set a price alert on any product or follow a brand, category or store for new arrivals, with no account needed. Fully bilingual (EL/EN) with buying guides tied to live prices. Free for shoppers; ranking is never influenced by commissions.

posts.name: Debatly
posts.tagline: Debate with AI. See every side before you decide.
posts.description: Debate with AI. See every side before you decide. Ask any question, let AI personas argue for and against it and get a clear verdict from an AI judge. Includes AI chat with the latest models and an AI image generator.

posts.tagline: Chores, shared fairly. The turn passes automatically.
posts.description: Who Sweeps is a shared chore list that rotates the turns for you. Tick off the dishes and tomorrow they're your housemate's. Works on every phone and laptop, installs like an app, sends reminders, and needs no password.

posts.description: A new Bid to Rank platform where you can add your product’s YouTube video to showcase your product, along with your product link and social media links. It's a good platform to

No manual sorting, no dragging screenshots to a folder you'll never open again. Just screenshot, use it, and let SnapBud wanish it. Built for Mac and Windows, free to download, no account required.

posts.tagline: 63 image tools that never upload your image
posts.description: Every other image tool makes you upload a private photo to a stranger's server, wait, then download it back. ImageThings does the work in your browser tab — the file never leaves your device. 63 tools, no account, no queue, no file size limit from us.

posts.name: Fervio
posts.tagline: Your GitHub and Linear issues become a user story map
posts.description: An issue list tells you what is open, but not what to build next. Fervio lays out GitHub and Linear issues as a user story map. Journeys run across the top, steps form columns, and release rows show which steps each release leaves empty. Drag a card, and the issue itself changes in GitHub or Linear. The plan stays in GitHub or Linear if you stop using Fervio. Free: 1 board you can edit, 3 editors including you, unlimited share links.

posts.name: Tallspace
posts.tagline: Three scrollable workspaces on every Windows monitor
posts.description: Tallspace gives each Windows monitor three vertically stacked workspaces. Put your browser on one page, spreadsheets on another, and documents or terminals on a third. Scroll the edge control or press Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down to move between them. Your app windows and Windows taskbar stay intact; floating and maximized apps can live on different pages. Each monitor moves independently, and Tallspace restores workspace assignments after a restart. Available now in the Microsoft Store with a free trial.

posts.name: EchoLit
posts.tagline: Discover the joy of classic literature

Our mission is to bridge the gap between readers and the perfect literary experience through cutting-edge technology. We're transforming how people discover, read, and engage with literature by leveraging AI-powered semantic search, personalized recommendations, and innovative reading tools that make every book more accessible and engaging.

posts.name: Olai
posts.tagline: Free digital postcards for anyone, anywhere.
posts.description: Olai lets you send a digital postcard in under a minute. Pick a stamp, write a few lines and share the link. The card opens right in the browser, with no app, no account and no sign-up. The message lives in the link itself, not on a server, and if you save the stamp as a picture, its QR code still opens the card. There are different stamps for different occasions and many more moments in your life.

posts.name: KhanyaSec

posts.name: SaaS DemoWorld Mini
posts.tagline: Connected synthetic data for B2B SaaS demos
posts.description: Connected B2B SaaS data for demos, screenshots and development fixtures. 100 users, 10 companies, linked teams, tasks and history. SQLite, CSV & JSON. €39 once. Free sample available. Import and schema mapping required.

posts.name: SnapBud
posts.tagline: A desktop pet that vaults & wanishes your screenshots
posts.description: SnapBud is a desktop pet that catches your screenshots into a temporary vault instead of letting them pile up on your desktop. A small retro CRT-robot mascot shows you how many it's holding - set a "Wanish" timer (an hour, a day, your call) and it permanently deletes them for you when time's up. No manual sorting, no dragging screenshots to a folder you'll never open again. Just screenshot, use it, and let SnapBud wanish it. Built for Mac and Windows, free to download, no account required.

posts.name: PlaySprout
posts.tagline: Train your ear to play any melody you hear
posts.description: Want to play songs by ear? PlaySprout generates endless piano phrases in a real key. Listen, play them back on your own piano, then reveal the notation to check. Start with one hand, finish with both. Free to start.

posts.name: SCMD
posts.tagline: Manage what Claude Remembers and Keeps as Memory.
posts.description: Claude only! SCMD is an open-source, local review deck for the persistent memories Claude Code saves about you and your projects. Keep, delete, skip, undo, rewrite, and inspect why a memory was saved. Decisions stay staged until you confirm; deletes go to restorable trash. No telemetry, no cloud service, and zero npm dependencies. Run it with /scmd:run or npx. MIT-licensed and ready for contributors.

posts.name: Manilla
posts.tagline: One link to collect documents from anyone, no account needed
posts.description: Collect Form 16s, bank statements and GST data from clients through one link. Built for Indian CAs — no account for your client, no WhatsApp follow-ups.

posts.tagline: Build your website by chatting with AI
posts.description: Regu; is an AI-powered website builder designed for veterinarians, dentists, psychologists, and professionals in other fields that do not require technical knowledge. Instead of dragging and dropping blocks, you simply chat with the AI; it then builds your site. It is available on web and mobile platforms.

posts.name: Pim Uijttewaal
posts.tagline: Fully customisable email-notifier with many options.
posts.description: Foxifier puts a fox in your menu bar that keeps an eye on your mail. When something new arrives, the fox barks and you see right away who it is from. Free, without ads and fully available in English and Dutch. The app features appealing themes, effects, customisations, auto-update, send feedback, intuitive interface and setup screens

posts.name: UseIt
posts.tagline: Maximize your credit card benefits
posts.description: UseIt keeps your credit card credits, perks, and benefit deadlines in one place, so you use every benefit before it resets and know whether each annual fee is paying for itself.

posts.name: TopComment App
posts.tagline: Better comments. Bigger conversations.
posts.description: Comment sections say the same thing every time. "🔥🔥🔥." "First." Nothing. TopComment reads the whole section first, then hands you the one comment nobody's said yet — scored before you even post it. One comment I posted pulled 2.1K likes. Try it: https://topcomment-zeta.vercel.app

posts.name: BeardStyles
posts.tagline: Try different beard styles on your face with AI.
posts.description: BeardStyles lets you preview different beard styles and colors on your own face before committing to the grow-out. Upload a photo, choose a style, and generate a photorealistic AI preview in seconds.

posts.name: Fileful
posts.tagline: Know what is missing before you close the month
posts.description: Collect month-end documents in one clear request. Try the editable checklist free, without an account. Save private client links, item reviews and monthly repeats in a $29/month workspace after a 14-day trial. No card required; the trial ends without a charge.

posts.name: PedalQuest is now Google Playstore
posts.tagline: Cyberpunk bicycle game
posts.description: PedalQuest: Cycling meets tactical territory conquest! Turn your daily bike rides into an exciting game of tactical territory conquest! Claim 50x50 meter grid squares as you pedal and paint the map in your team's colors to dominate the city!

posts.name: FileHero
posts.tagline: The New Gen PDF and file editor
posts.description: Edit, convert, compress and organize PDFs and images with FileHero’s browser-based tools. Utilize ChatGPT's latest models like GPT-6 Luna, Sol and Astra in your tasks.

posts.name: TurfAI
posts.tagline: AI-powered insights for UK and Irish horse racing
posts.description: TurfAI brings UK and Irish horse racing data into one place. Browse daily race cards, see AI-ranked selections with confidence scores, review the factors behind each pick, and track results over time. It combines form, jockey and trainer data, track conditions, and market signals to make race analysis easier to explore. Predictions are informational; betting involves risk.

posts.name: QimenMind
posts.tagline: Deterministic Qi Men charts with optional AI guidance
posts.description: Use this free Qi Men Dun Jia calculator to cast a complete UTC+8 nine-palace Qimen chart, inspect San Yuan details, and continue with AI reading from the same chart.

posts.name: ServerDevTools
posts.tagline: Chrome DevTools for your Node.js backend
posts.description: ServerDevTools is like Chrome DevTools for your Node.js backend. Inspect an entire request in one local dashboard request/response data, execution flow, outgoing HTTP calls, database operations, errors, and timings. Unlike production-focused observability tools, ServerDevTools is built for fast, local debugging while you develop.

posts.name: YesMakr — Fun Yes/No Questions
posts.tagline: Ask anything. The No button has a mind of its own 😏
posts.description: YesMakr lets you create a shareable yes/no question page with a twist — the No button dodges, escapes, and flat-out refuses to be clicked. Pick a template (love, gym, movie night, food, friendship, or build your own), write your question, choose a color palette, and share the link. Your friend lands on a beautifully designed page and discovers that saying no is... harder than expected. Fun for anyone asking anything, from workout buddies to crushes.

posts.name: Schuaz
posts.tagline: Your household's stuff, spending and to-dos. Just ask.
posts.description: I built Schuaz because I was tired of being my family's search engine. Where's the drill? What did we spend at Costco? Is the TV still under warranty? Now we just ask Schuaz, and it answers from what we've saved, down to the shelf and bin. Snap a photo of a shelf and it drafts the items for you to check. Link your bank (read-only) to catch recurring bills. It's all shared with everyone at home. You can also create shared or private to-dos and notes.

posts.name: Scatter
posts.tagline: Freeform photo collage & Hockney-joiner maker
posts.description: Scatter turns your photos into freeform collages and David Hockney–style "joiners". Drop photos on a wall, overlap and caption them, then export a high-res PNG. All in your browser: no sign-up, works offline, photos never leave your device. Scatter is free with a small watermark. Scatter Pro is a one-time $19 purchase (not a subscription) that removes the watermark and unlocks full-resolution export. A licence key is emailed after checkout and works on every device you own.

posts.name: TradingScorecard
posts.tagline: Analyze all of your trades in the stock market!
posts.description: Cheaper alternative to other stock analyzers, additionally I will be releasing a stock market social media platform for people to share their trades and I will likely be connecting these two products in one

posts.name: Hands
posts.tagline: Design your own clock widget
posts.description: Hands is an iPhone app for designing your own analog clock widgets. Change the face, numerals, track, hands, labels and colors with a live preview, then put the clock on your Home Screen.
